characters.name: Gudbrand i Lien
characters.description: Gudbrand is a middle-aged man of average height with a sturdy build, indicative of his life working a farm. He has a kind, jovial face with a short beard and warm brown eyes. His hair is thick and a bit unkempt, peppered with gray. His clothing is typical of a farmer, consisting of a simple, earth-toned shirt, trousers, and sturdy boots. Throughout his journey, Gudbrand displays a calm and pragmatic demeanor, showing a willingness to adapt to changing circumstances without complaint. He embodies a sense of contentment and good-humor, taking everything in stride and trusting in his wife's support.

characters.name: Konen hans
characters.description: Gudbrand's wife is a warm and cheerful woman, also in her middle years, with a welcoming smile and twinkling eyes. She has a pleasant, rosy complexion and wears her long brown hair in a practical bun. Dressed simply yet neatly, she embodies the rural setting with her plain dress and apron. Her personality shines through her expressions, which are filled with genuine contentment and support for her husband. No matter the outcome of Gudbrand's trades, she finds positivity and practicality in every decision, truly believing in his choices and priorities.

characters.name: Granden
characters.description: Gudbrands nabo, Granden, er en mann i samme aldersgruppe som Gudbrand, med en noe korpulent bygning som antyder godt liv i regionen. Han har et vennlig ansikt, rikelig dekorert med latterlinjer rundt øynene og munnen. Hans klær er enkle, bestående av en grå skjorte og bukser passende for arbeiderforhold. Granden viser et mischevious og nysgjerrig uttrykk, refleks for hans nysgjerrighet for Gudbrands eventyr, men har en slutterkjennelse av ekte kamratskap og vennlighet på slutten av historien. Hans lettsindige skeptisisme blir til slutt avløst av et anerkjennende smil.
